title: Dental Emergencies
description: Covers toothache relief, saving a knocked-out tooth, broken or chipped teeth, and placing commercial or improvised temporary fillings. Includes managing dental abscesses and their danger signs, loose teeth, stray orthodontic wires, a dental emergency kit, and when to see a dentist.
shortDescription: Toothaches, knocked-out teeth, temporary fillings, and abscess care
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
